title: cyclosorus skinneri
intro: Cyclosorus skinneri, commonly known as the Indian Brake Fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine and is valued for its health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestive health, and lower cholesterol levels. The therapeutic actions of Cyclosorus skinneri include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and diuretic properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
